title: Stat Sorter
description: Defines a start sorter, which stat it should be based on, how the preview is formatted and how the sorter is labeled.

type.$comment: There's only one type registered in vanilla tetra, but this can be set if some other mod has registered other stat sorter types.

key.$comment: The localization key for the sorter, the localized value will be displayed in the sorter list. Probably something along the lines of 'mymod.stats.my_sorter'.

stat.$comment: The stat that the sorter should be based on. If this getter "should show" for any variant determines if the sorter shows in the dropdown.

format.$comment: Formatting used for the preview label that is shown for each variant while sorting is active.

inverted.description: If set to true, the sorter will be inverted and lower values will come out on top.
